archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-05.4 Generate Analytical and Interpretive Outputs
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Once the statistical products are verified, the organization develops analytical outputs and interpretations. This includes summaries, explanatory text, charts, and tables that help users understand the meaning and significance of the results. The outputs are designed to highlight trends, comparisons, and insights that arise from the data. Analysts work with communication experts to ensure clarity, neutrality, and accessibility. These interpretive outputs make the data more valuable by turning numbers into insightful narratives.
Value created: Analytical narratives that make complex statistical data understandable and relevant.
